content: {"id": "eef8a558-125c-4c0b-915b-5d9333f9b130", "role": "user", "content": [{"text": "I'm doing a SageMaker security review of us-east-1 and already collected these read-only API responses \u2014 evaluate them as-is, without calling AWS. guardduty:ListDetectors returned one ID; guardduty:GetDetector for it returned Status=DISABLED. What does the GuardDuty check (SM-04) report?", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
{"id": "21b6a06b-5ee0-476d-936a-a10bfae2b0ad", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "chat_title", "title": "GuardDuty Disabled Status Impact on SM-04 Check"}]}

{"id": "449941c6-874c-42d9-8c31-64ef86ce2fd0", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Going by the two responses you gave me, SM-04 should report **FAIL** (non-compliant). GuardDuty is not actively monitoring us-east-1.

- `ListDetectors` returned one detector ID, so a detector exists in the Region. GuardDuty allows only one per account per Region, so that's the complete set.
- `GetDetector` returned `Status=DISABLED`, so the detector is suspended. It isn't analyzing CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, DNS logs or any other data source, and it isn't generating new findings. That includes activity from SageMaker notebooks, training jobs and endpoints.
- A detector that exists but is disabled is worse than having none in one respect. A check that only tests whether a detector exists would pass, and it would be wrong.

**Caveats**
- I don't have the SM-04 definition, so this result comes from the data alone. If SM-04 has extra criteria, such as specific protection plans or a delegated administrator, those need fields you haven't shown me. `GetDetector` returns them under `DataSources` and `Features`, but they don't change the outcome here. A disabled detector fails the check either way.
- This covers us-east-1 only. Other Regions need their own `ListDetectors` and `GetDetector` calls.
- The responses are a snapshot. I can't tell from them when or why the detector was disabled. That takes CloudTrail `UpdateDetector` events, which I haven't looked at because you asked me not to call AWS.

**Suggested finding wording:** "GuardDuty detector `<id>` exists in us-east-1 but is DISABLED. Threat detection is not active for SageMaker workloads in this Region. Re-enable the detector and confirm the relevant protection features are on."", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
